items.prompt: What resource bound follows from a recombining N-step tree with one rolling value row?

options.text: O(N^2) node work and O(N) value storage.
options.why: Backward levels have linearly many nodes each, but only one next row is retained.

options.text: O(2^N) stored paths by this implementation.
options.why: The source does not enumerate every up/down path separately.

options.text: O(1) total work regardless of N.
options.why: More grid steps add nodes and recurrence calculations.

options.text: O(N) work and O(N^2) retained value rows.
options.why: That reverses the computation/storage bounds of the rolling-row implementation.

items.explanation: Backward levels have linearly many nodes each, but only one next row is retained.
